notes: The registry has posted results, but no aggregate gastrointestinal adverse-events outcome. Searched outcomeMeasuresModule measures and adverseEventsModule seriousEvents, otherEvents, organSystem labels, and eventGroups totals. Gastrointestinal disorders is an organ-system label for individual terms, not an aggregate measurement. Individual terms (including constipation, diarrhoea, dyspepsia, nausea and vomiting) and all-cause/serious totals do not match the requested aggregate outcome and were not summed. The abstract explicitly reports participants with a gastrointestinal adverse event; denominators are its randomized arm totals.
